about_the_game:
STARVAULT: PC Spectator is a standalone viewing client that lets anyone watch STARVAULT matches, tournaments, and replay files - even if you don’t own the main game.

Experience the action of a VR MOBA-shooter directly on your PC:

• Watch replay files out of the box

Load community-shared or official tournament replay files and freely control the camera without needing the STARVAULT game.

• Live match spectating (optional)

If STARVAULT players are hosting live matches, you can join as a spectator and switch between cinematic cameras, top-down views, or free-cam.

• Built for streamers and community events

Capture clean footage, follow specific heroes, or set up customized broadcast angles - all without a VR headset.

Whether you’re a streamer, content creator, tournament organizer, or just curious about the game, the Spectator client works fully on its own and gives you a complete viewing experience right away.

No purchase of STARVAULT is required to use this application.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 470 or greater
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
